name: paid_enquiries_by_campaign_and_stage
description: Paid enquiries grouped by Google campaign and by search term, showing how far each group's deals got — how many never passed qualification, how many got to pre-quote, quote, or negotiation, and how many were won. Use for 'how far do paid leads get', 'which campaigns bring leads that go nowhere', 'are our ads bringing quality traffic', 'which search terms actually turn into quotes', 'where do paid enquiries drop out'. This answers how far paid traffic GETS; for what a campaign EARNED use the closed-won value by campaign skill. A high stuck-pre-qualification share is a targeting problem, not a sales one — worth saying. CRITICAL: an enquiry appears once under campaign and once under search term, so never total across both groupings — report one at a time and say which. Campaign IDs are Google's numbers, not names; present them as ids and never invent a campaign name.

params.name: grouped_by
params.description: Which grouping to report: 'campaign' or 'search term'. Almost always worth setting — the two are not comparable and must not be totalled together.

params.name: campaign_or_term
params.description: Narrow to one campaign id or search term, e.g. 'crittall'.

params.name: min_enquiries
params.description: Only campaigns or terms with at least this many enquiries. Use to ignore one-offs that cannot support a percentage.
